name: Balkány (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Balkány: a red and blue shield with a black eagle and a swan, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed BALKÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Balkány arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
